title: list
description: Numbered, lettered, bulleted or checklist items revealed one by one. `shown` says how many items are visible (hidden ones keep their space), `done` ticks a checklist, `active` emphasises one item. Set the state props per step with `advance` or `set` on the slide.

items.description: The items, in order. `text` and `sub` are inline Markdown (emphasis, code, links); raw HTML is shown as text. `id` names an item for `done` and `active`; it defaults to the item's index as a string, and ids must be unique.

id.description: Optional unique id, used by `done` and `active`.

sub.description: An optional second line under the item, inline Markdown.

marker.description: The marker before each item: `number` (1. 2. 3.), `letter` (a. b. c., always latin), `bullet`, or `check` (a box that ticks when the item is done).

shown.description: How many items are visible (items 0..shown-1); all when absent. Hidden items keep their space, so the list never reflows. New items rise and fade in, staggered, on a forward step.

done.description: For `check`: how many items from the top are done (a number), or the ids of the done items (a list). An unknown id is an error. A check mark draws when an item becomes done and comes off when it is not.

active.description: One item emphasised: its index or its id. The others dim; the change fades. An unknown id is an error.

rule.description: Draw an accent rule on the left of the list.
